name: tynd
description: Native desktop apps in TypeScript — workspace root.
author: Kevin Petit <74395438+kvnpetit@users.noreply.github.com> (https://github.com/kvnpetit)

scripts.check: biome ci --error-on-warnings && bun scripts/gen-api-catalog.ts --check && bun scripts/gen-mcp-catalog.ts --check && bun scripts/check-lint-tables.ts && node --check npm/tooling/index.js && node --check packages/cli/bin/index.js && node --check packages/mcp/bin/index.js && node npm/tooling/scripts/check-platform-packages.js --metadata-only && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-sdk && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli && tsc --noEmit -p packages/test && tsc --noEmit -p packages/host-src && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && bun run --cwd apps/docs typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p plugins/host && tsc --noEmit -p plugins/standalone && cargo check --locked --workspace && bun run test
scripts.check:full: bun run check && bash scripts/check-host-feature-matrix.sh && bun run test:plugins
scripts.test: bun test scripts packages/cli packages/core packages/plugin-sdk packages/test
